name: TotalSegmentator datasets v2.0.1 and v3.0.0
what: whole-body CT with every vertebra among the segmented structures: v2.0.1, 1,228 volumes (Zenodo 10047292), and v3.0.0, 1,935 volumes (Zenodo 22688904); how many of v3's are v2's is not written here

segmentations.masks: 117 structures in v2.0.1, every vertebra among them named by level, with no L6 or T13 label, as s*/segmentations/*.nii.gz
segmentations.by: the release's authors, automatic and refined by hand

segmentations.masks: the same structures in v3.0.0, with refined bone labels
segmentations.by: the release's authors, automatic and refined by hand

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks of v3's CTs, each vertebra named by level, relabelled in tsv3_ctd
segmentations.by: the owner's runs, automatic (SPINEPS); no radiologist has read them

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks of v2's 1,228 CTs, each vertebra named by level
segmentations.by: the owner's runs, automatic (SPINEPS with VERIDAH); no radiologist has read them

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/totalsegmentator_v201; /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/totalsegmentator_v300, downloaded from Zenodo and checked, 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-19; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/totalsegmentator/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/totalsegmentator_v201; /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/totalsegmentator_v300, downloaded from Zenodo and checked, 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-19, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry
